angular-fundamentals-sr4-10.statement: With `on interaction; prefetch on idle`, the @defer placeholder stays after the idle prefetch.

angular-fundamentals-sr5-11.statement: An effect created in a root-provided service's constructor outlives the component that injected the service.

angular-fundamentals-sr7-10.statement: Angular automatically ends programmatic subscriptions to an output() when its owning component is destroyed.

angular-fundamentals-sr9-09.statement: With Eager change detection, changing a non-signal bound field in ngAfterViewInit passes Angular's dev-mode check.
